question: Will Bitcoin reach its all-time high (~$126,080) before end of 2027?

model.prompt_context:

- "No": Wins if the BTC/USD price on CoinGecko does not reach or exceed $126,198 at any point strictly after 2026-09-29T16:06:59.462Z and at or before 2027-12-31T23:00:00.000Z.

- The threshold of $126,198 refers to Bitcoin's approximate all-time high as of the market's creation date; a single intraday price print at or above this level within the specified window is sufficient for "Yes" to win.
